usageSelection.title: Captain selection
usageSelection.description: Choose how Armada compares eligible captains within the existing routing preferences. Observe records the proposed choice while preserving current routing.
usageSelection.adminOnly: Only a global administrator can change captain selection settings.
usageSelection.enforcementUnavailable: Enforcement is not available on this server.
usageSelection.strategyHint: First available keeps the existing order. Most remaining favors headroom; most used favors accounts nearer their limits. Safety gates still apply.
usageSelection.environment: An environment override controls this policy. Change ARMADA_USAGE_SELECTION to edit it.
usageSelection.loadFailed: Captain selection settings could not be loaded.
usageSelection.saveFailed: Captain selection settings could not be saved.
usageSelection.saved: Captain selection settings saved and applied.
usageSelection.invalid: Enter valid values. Comfortable headroom must exceed the reserve.
usageSelection.enforceDescription: Enforce chooses a qualified captain using this strategy and reserves estimated account allowance before launch.
usageSelection.disabledDescription: Disabled keeps the existing captain order and quota holds without recording new selection decisions.
usageSelection.historyLoadFailed: Selection details could not be refreshed.
usageSelection.noMatchingHistory: No recorded selections match this filter.
usageSelection.noCandidates: No candidate rows are available for this comparison.
usageSelection.noHistory: Selection history was not recorded for this attempt.
usageSelection.observeChoice: The current routing chose this captain. Compare the configured strategy's proposal below.
usageSelection.reason.headroom: Enough allowance remains after estimated reservations.
usageSelection.reason.reserve: Remaining allowance would cross the protected reserve.
usageSelection.reason.exhausted: An applicable account limit is exhausted.
usageSelection.reason.cooldown: The account is waiting after a provider rate limit.
usageSelection.reason.identity: No verified account usage is available.
usageSelection.reason.configuration: Usage was captured for a different configuration.
usageSelection.reason.missing: No account usage capture is available.
usageSelection.reason.future: The observation time is unexpectedly in the future.
usageSelection.reason.stale: Usage is too old to authorize a known allowance.
usageSelection.reason.authority: This source does not provide authoritative usage.
usageSelection.reason.debt: Earlier work still needs a post-execution account capture.
usageSelection.reason.windows: No reported limit window applies to this model.
usageSelection.reason.invalid: Reported usage is incomplete or invalid.
usageSelection.reason.model: The intended model is unknown for a model-specific limit.
usageSelection.reason.scope: The reported limit scope cannot be verified.
usageSelection.reason.reset: A fresh capture is required after the reported reset.
usageSelection.reason.eligible: No eligible captain is currently available.
usageSelection.reason.limit: The comparison exceeds the configured candidate limit.
usageSelection.reason.host: Capture usage on the host selected for execution.
usageSelection.reason.hostUnknown: The execution credential host is unresolved.
usageSelection.reason.missionScope: The mission has no valid tenant scope.
usageSelection.reason.notPending: Only Pending missions can preview a new selection.
usageSelection.reason.review: The author cannot review this mission.
usageSelection.reason.ownership: This captain is outside the mission's authorized scope.
usageSelection.reason.envelope: The captain does not meet the mission's model requirements.
usageSelection.reason.routing: Existing routing or safety rules exclude this captain.
usageSelection.reason.exception: An authorized exception allows use of the soft reserve.
usageSelection.reason.placement: Waiting for an eligible execution host with the required credentials.
usageSelection.reason.retry: Waiting for the current launch recovery cycle.
usageSelection.reason.voyage: The parent voyage can no longer run this mission.
usageSelection.latestRetained: Latest retained decision; this is not the current execution attempt.
usageSelection.recovery.title: Recovery permissions
usageSelection.recovery.scope: Applies to this mission only. New permissions affect future admissions; running work continues.
usageSelection.recovery.fallbackHelp: Use another qualified captain when the preferred captain cannot run. Strict assignments remain strict.
usageSelection.recovery.reserveHelp: May use protected reserve, but must still fit the attempt estimate. Exhausted quota and cooldowns still block.
usageSelection.recovery.audit: Your identity, reason and permission revision are retained in the audit history. Do not include credentials.
usageSelection.reason.fallbackPermission: Using another captain requires an administrator to allow eligible fallback for this mission.
usageSelection.recovery.conflict: Permissions changed or this mission is no longer Pending. Refresh before retrying.
usageSelection.tuiEmpty: Open this tab to inspect captain selection.
usageSelection.recovery.unavailable: Recovery permissions require a tenant or system administrator and a Pending mission.
usageSelection.recovery.saveFailed: Recovery permissions could not be saved.
usageSelection.conflict: Another administrator changed these settings. Refresh before saving again.
usageSelection.reservations.estimate: Estimated Armada reservations: {{active}} running, {{unsettled}} awaiting settlement (not provider usage)
usageSelection.reservations.uncertain: Some estimated usage on this account is not settled yet. Captain selection treats it as uncertain until a fresh capture.
usageSelection.reason.routed: Chosen by the existing routing order; Observe does not change routing.
usageSelection.reason.fallback: An administrator's recovery permission allowed fallback from the preferred captain.
usageSelection.omitted: Other captains considered but not listed: {{count}}
usageSelection.omittedHint: History lists the captains that explain a decision and counts the rest by reason. Preview shows every captain now.
usageSelection.missionWaiting: Mission created but not assigned to a captain yet. Armada retries automatically; the mission's Captain selection section explains any selection wait.
usageSelection.redispatchHint: Armada dispatched this mission again by itself after an attempt that produced no work or was interrupted.
